capabilities: Read and modify files, run shell commands, inspect images, and manage background processes.
description: Read the current status and new output of a shell task started by Bash. Always non-blocking. Completion is reported automatically; use this for a progress check you will act on. Only output since the previous read is returned, bounded to 60000 characters. This tool manages shell tasks only; no full-log output_path is provided.

task_id.description: The background shell task ID to inspect.

name: TaskOutput
